title: How to Beat EVERY Boss in RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: SuperStooob
chapters: Kuldra: Anima, pylons and cannon stages
description:
Get your first kill on Dragonwilds’ main bosses with this RuneScape: Dragonwilds boss guide, covering Velgar, Imaru, Black Knight Titan, Fuzan and Kuldra.

Bring up to five friends into your Dragonwilds world:
https://berrybyte.net/a/superstooob
Use code STOOOB20 for 20% off.

I break down the food, gear, supplies and strategy for each fight, using equipment you can get before beating that boss. Learn the attacks, find your damage windows and handle the mechanics that can end an otherwise good run.

These are practical first-clear strategies, not speedrun setups. Use the recommended loadouts or adapt the approach to your own playstyle.

AD | Sponsored by Berrybyte
Bring up to five friends into your Dragonwilds world:
https://berrybyte.net/a/superstooob
Use code STOOOB20 for 20% off.

BOSSES COVERED
• Velgar  preparation, melee positioning and poison barrages
• Imaru  healing buffs, spectral stages, summons and purification
• Black Knight Titan  ranged kiting, agility and the fiery second stage
• Fuzan  preparation for the 10-wave challenge, pillar cover and the “pizza” mechanic
• Kuldra  hatchlings, Anima pylons, the Resonator and the heart
